title: Deploy OVH systemd/Compose, Cloudflare Access, and read-only status projection
oracle: Service restart self-heals without local/launchd/Agent dependency; public UI is protected by Cloudflare Access; status projection is read-only.
threshold: 所有 blocking assertion PASS；UNKNOWN、NOT_RUN、WAIVED 均不是 PASS
